title: A mark's words the agent wrote between its calls are replaced, as in any record, once a later turn replays its round from the stored row, while the tool's result is replayed as written
notes: The agent writes the words of the application's instruction mark before its call, and the tool's result holds them too. The next turn replays the round from the agent's stored rows: what the agent wrote between its calls is rewritten as any record is, its copy of the mark replaced, and the tool's result is replayed as written. Within the turn neither is rewritten (tools/a-mark-s-words-in-the-agent-s-own-rounds-and-a-tool-s-result-are-replayed-as-written), and a copy a hook writes into the messages itself reaches the model as written (tools/a-mark-s-copy-a-generation-hook-writes-into-the-messages-reaches-the-model-as-written). Python: channels/_ai_context.py reads the history's records through channels/_mark_copies.py without_mark_copies; roomkit-rs: roomkit-core rules/transcript.
